en-US.title: Office file preview
en-US.description: Preview Excel, Word and PowerPoint files in the side panel with an installed browser extension.

usage.title: Open an Office file
usage.description: Open an XLSX, DOCX or PPTX attachment or generated file in the right-hand reader.

usage.title: Search and navigate
usage.description: Search displayed text and use worksheet tabs, page controls, outlines or thumbnails. Search shows up to 2,000 matches.

usage.title: Download the original
usage.description: Download the original when a format is unsupported or a file exceeds preview limits.

requirements: Ask your administrator to install the Office preview extension, restart Gateway and refresh the browser.
Read-only XLSX, DOCX and PPTX files are supported, subject to the resource limits in the package guide.

zh-CN.title: Office 文件预览
zh-CN.description: 安装浏览器扩展后，在右侧面板预览 Excel、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件。

usage.title: 打开 Office 文件
usage.description: 在右侧阅读面板打开 XLSX、DOCX 或 PPTX 附件或生成的文件。

usage.title: 搜索与导航
usage.description: 搜索显示的文字，并使用工作表标签、翻页、大纲或缩略图导航；最多显示 2,000 处匹配。

usage.title: 下载原始文件
usage.description: 文件格式不受支持或超过预览限制时，可下载原始文件。

requirements: 请管理员安装 Office 预览扩展、重启 Gateway，并刷新浏览器。
支持只读预览 XLSX、DOCX 和 PPTX，资源限制详见扩展使用说明。
